stanza: So if it ever comes time

fiddle.line: Singing boy, pick up that fiddle
stanza: Singing boy, pick up that fiddle
Ooh and play that steel guitar

Ooh and dance right where you are
Hey, hey
Hey, hey

middle.line: You climb out the chimney and meet me in the middle
stanza: You climb out the chimney and meet me in the middle
The middle of the town

middle.line: Fried morels and fine hotels and all that in the middle
stanza: Fried morels and fine hotels and all that in the middle
Every bite and curtain drawn, I wanna taste with you
Goddess in my Days Inn pen, the muse I ain't refusin'
The part of me that ain't around I'm always talking to

middle.line: Put 'em on the side, put 'em in the middle
stanza: Well, you can go out to eat and that's for sure
But it's nothin' a homegrown tomato won't cure
Put 'em in a salad, put 'em in a stew
You can make your very own tomato juice

Put 'em on the side, put 'em in the middle
Put a homegrown tomato on a hotcake griddle

middle.line: You got it, it's dead, it's in the middle

Dead skunk in the middle of the road
Stinking to high heaven
All over the road
Technicolor
Oh, you got pollution

middle.line: With a perfect little bow around the middle
stanza: This is not your ordinary ballad
With a perfect little bow around the middle

middle.line: I hope there's some room still in the middle

middle.line: And there stood in the middle

Guess who?

riddle.line: Full moon in Pisces, a reflective riddle
stanza: Full moon in Pisces, a reflective riddle
Illusory shadows upon open wounds
Wars of our fathers bouncing like pinball machines
Between me and my brother stands our sister, don’t shoot!
